reason: I have no car, and there is no home delivery, so someone in my family would still have to go to the pickup point every evening between 6 and 8. Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time is a hassle, and the $2 per bag is money I can't easily spare when we are counting every dollar.
objection: No delivery. If I can't get there myself, my son or a neighbour has to collect the bag, and that is the same favour I ask for the shopping now. Then I pay $2 on top for it.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door, or a pickup point within walking distance that is open late enough for whoever brings it, with no fee on small orders.
